figB1_dose_response.finding: Caption change is cheap and monotone in alpha (ablate 7-34%, swap 7-39% at alpha 0.5-4; n=100/point) while concept-DIRECTED change is rare (D39 validated: 7/215 = 3.3% of the earlier run's changed generations, needing alpha 5-14x); the x9b add grid runs at k-normalized alpha ~27-2348, entirely in the degeneration zone, and its raw word-presence directed flag (20-60% of changed) counts repetition collapse as directed - the validated 3.3% line is the honest figure.

figB2_cure_test.finding: Mean-replacement ablation of the hallucinated category's J-lens direction at alpha=1 removes 0.50/0.60/0.70/0.90 of hallucinations at L16/24/28/30 while grounded-category retention stays 1.00 on those arms; ablating a GROUNDED category's direction is destructive (retention falls 0.97 -> 0.35 by L30) - a training-free 90% surgical cure at L30.

figB3_commitment_boundary.finding: Visual content is causally live at image positions only until ~L16-20: patching all 576 image tokens changes the caption at rate 1.00 -> 0.125 across L0-24 (A-objects vanish 1.00 -> 0 by L24; B-objects appear 0.41-0.49 only through L16), and single-token patches do nothing (<= 0.25) - the commitment boundary sits at L20-24 and content is distributed.

figB4_prior_grounding_race.finding: The language prior leads from L0 (hallucinated words rank ~787 vs grounded ~5358) while grounding is computed (5358 -> 1.18); the two trajectories cross at L24-26, the image's true objects surface at the last prompt position (mean 1423 at L16 -> best 34 at L20 -> 6-15 at L22-25), and the L31 motor regime flips the readout to the imminent token (mean rank 3464) - hallucination is the prior's default, grounding the computation that must overtake it.

figB5_detector_ledger.finding: Hallucination is best predicted by calibrated workspace content, not attention: the pre-generation yes/no gap nearly solves object presence (0.985 over 185 questions; 0.895 as a low-gap detector of the model's own hallucinated yes), while caption-level risk is a 0.6-0.73 problem (fused 0.666) and the attention mirror is NULL (0.501); all lens detectors are training-free and single-pass.
